name: Crunchy Butterscotch Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Cashew Crackles (10%) [Liquid Glucose, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Cashew, Palm Kernel Oil], Emulsifier (471), Stabilisers (412, 466, 407), Synthetic Food Colours (102), Artificial (Butterscotch & Caramel) Flavouring Substances. ALLERGEN INFORMATION: Contains Milk and Cashew. May Contain Almond, Pistachio, Soy and Wheat Flour.
